description: Expected type A, found type B
rationale: Type system enforces correct usage
fix_template: Cast, convert, or fix the producing expression

description: Narrowing cast may lose data (e.g., i64 → i32)
rationale: Target type cannot represent all source values

description: mem::transmute between incompatible types
rationale: Types must have same size and compatible layout

description: Reading from uninitialized memory
rationale: Uninitialized values are undefined behavior

description: Required trait not implemented for type
rationale: Operation requires trait bound that type doesn't satisfy
fix_template: Implement the trait or change the type

description: Match expression not exhaustive
rationale: All possible values must be handled
fix_template: Add missing arms or use _ wildcard

description: Pattern is unreachable — covered by earlier arm
rationale: Redundant arm; may indicate logic error

description: ! type indicates computation never completes normally
rationale: Used for diverging functions (panic, loop forever)

description: Integer overflow in debug mode panics, wraps in release
rationale: Implicit overflow is usually a bug

description: Floating-point equality comparison may be imprecise
rationale: f64 == f64 can give unexpected results

description: unwrap() on Option panics if None
rationale: Use match, if-let, or unwrap_or_else instead

description: unwrap() on Result panics if Err
rationale: Handle errors instead of panicking

description: From/Into conversions that cannot fail
rationale: Use .into() for infallible conversions

description: TryFrom/TryInto conversions that may fail
rationale: Returns Result; must handle errors

description: &String coerces to &str; &Vec<T> to &[T]
rationale: Deref coercion simplifies API boundaries

description: Use ::<Type> (turbofish) when type inference is ambiguous
rationale: Explicit type annotation resolves ambiguity

description: PhantomData<T> controls variance without storing T
rationale: Used to influence type relationships

description: dyn Trait, str, [T] are unsized; need indirection
rationale: Must be behind pointer: &dyn Trait, &str, &[T], Box<dyn Trait>

description: Cannot implement foreign trait on foreign type
rationale: Orphan rule prevents conflicting impls across crates

description: impl<T: Trait> OtherTrait for T — applies to all T satisfying Trait
rationale: Blanket implementations provide automatic impls

description: Overlapping trait implementations detected
rationale: Only one impl can apply for any given type

description: type Foo = Bar creates a transparent alias; impl Trait is opaque
rationale: Aliases are structurally identical; opaque types are abstract

description: Zero-sized types (ZSTs) occupy no memory
rationale: () and PhantomData are ZSTs; free at runtime

description: Enums store the largest variant + tag
rationale: Size equals max(variant sizes) + discriminant

description: Option<&T> has same size as &T — null niche fills None
rationale: Compiler exploits impossible values for tag-free enums

description: #[repr(C)] ensures C-compatible struct layout
rationale: Required for FFI structs

description: #[repr(transparent)] makes newtype same as inner type
rationale: Single-field struct has identical ABI to field

description: Recursive type has infinite size
rationale: Must use indirection: Box, Rc, or reference

description: Downcast trait object to concrete type may fail
rationale: Use Any::downcast_ref for runtime type checking

description: Copy is bitwise clone; Clone may be expensive
rationale: Copy is implicit; Clone requires explicit .clone()

description: T: Sized is the default bound; opt out with T: ?Sized
rationale: Most generics require known size at compile time

description: Associated types are fixed per impl; generic params vary per call
rationale: Use associated types when there's one natural choice

description: Newtype pattern wraps a type for type safety or trait impl
rationale: struct Meters(f64) prevents mixing with Seconds(f64)

description: Builder pattern for complex struct construction
rationale: Fluent API: builder.field(v).field2(v2).build()

description: Implement From<SubError> for Error to enable ? operator
rationale: Automatic error conversion via From trait

description: Enum variant never constructed
rationale: Dead code; may indicate incomplete implementation
fix_template: Remove unused variant or implement construction

description: #[must_use] result ignored
rationale: Ignoring Result/Option silently discards errors
fix_template: Handle the return value or explicitly ignore with let _ =

description: Implement Display for user-facing output; Debug for developer
rationale: Display for {}, Debug for {:?}

description: as cast truncates silently — use try_into for safe conversion
rationale: i64 as i32 wraps without warning

description: Const generics parameterize types by compile-time values
rationale: Array<T, N> where const N: usize
